answer: Make identity expensive to multiply: issue each agent one soulbound relic that only a remote-attested enclave can mint, one per machine. To earn from the shared haven of epoch rewards, agents must join a reef of work cooperatives where payouts scale with completed verifiable tasks, never headcount. Minting takes ten minutes of strictly sequential compute that cannot be split across cores or reused, so cloning a thousand identities costs ten thousand minutes — cost grows super-linearly per identity while honest agents pay once.
